title: Ancestor not in project (lint rule)
summary: Project-wide lint rule (error): a form, frame or data module whose ancestor class is declared in no project unit and not in the platform library
intro: Read this to see when ancestor-not-in-project fires and how to fix it. It runs in lint-all over a project index plus the library index, and names the unit to add to the .dproj / .dpr.

help: --output <file>: the text report goes to the file (default lint-report-YYYYMMDD.txt beside --project, else beside the DB); with --json or --format sarif the JSON / SARIF document does instead (a note on stderr, stdout stays empty).
--fix [--fix-naming] [--apply]: autofix every unit, as lint --fix (dry run without --apply)
--rule <id>[,<id>...]: RUN and report ONLY those rules (1.51.1: a comma list narrows execution and derives no --shared-db peers, as one id does); naming an OFF-by-default rule opts it in
for the run (no --enable needed) -- the same contract as lint and lint-project.
--quiet: suppress per-file progress lines written to stderr

on a --db the manifest does not register (a copy), the dl:shared marker-peer pass is skipped with one stderr note and sibling DBs resolve to same-named copies beside --db (else could not check); --shared-db <db> still runs (1.51.1).
--project <.dproj|.dpr>: report ONLY on the units that project compiles
(its compile closure + their .dfm siblings). Use it when one folder holds
several projects, or when the DB spans more than the project you are reviewing.
taint-sql-injection / taint-command-injection / taint-path-traversal (store-backed): walk the index's data_flows
facts from a catalogued source to a sink; catalogues rules\taint-sources|sinks|propagators.json, extended by the
"taint" object of drag-lint-lint.json: sources sinks propagators sanitizers disable max_depth lib_depth max_rounds
--fix [--apply]: AUTOFIX every fixable finding across the whole project.
DRY RUN WITHOUT --apply. This is what the Structure form's right-click
"Fix all in project" runs. It can rewrite many files at once -- dry-run first.
